warning.titlePre: Range Rover Sport HSE Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Range Rover Sport HSE is a pre-2022 model with the TDV6 or SDV6 diesel V6 - that's the L320 or L494 generation - timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks and crankshaft bearing failure risk are well-documented patterns on this engine family. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every TDV6/SDV6 rebuild.

The newer L461 generation uses Ingenium diesel and petrol engines - a different design family with improved reliability. It also offers BMW-sourced V8 options (P530) that follow their own well-known hot-vee pattern, but these are not independently confirmed for the Sport specifically at this time.
warning.source: Source: same as Range Rover TDV6/SDV6 pattern (per G-BRF). L461 Ingenium MHEV DC-DC risk flagged unconfirmed; PHEV-specific pattern missing; N63/S68 inherited by platform-sharing inference, not independently re-verified for Sport specifically
